description: Free check to make before any cross-chain USDC/USDT transfer. Send the evaluation request body (from recta_request_template; no wallet and no address needed: only the corridor, amount and baseline_provider are required; sender, recipient, constraints and gas ceilings are filled when absent and listed in `assumed`; your own sender gives the most exact figure) and get, for the route you would use, its estimated total cost in USDC and when it arrives; and, when Recta proves a cheaper route, the saving (a proven lower bound), Recta's 5 % fee, that route's total cost and arrival (the route itself is not named) and execute_via_recta: sign the same body to get the route. Stores nothing, charges nothing; shares the trial's 3 a day per IP address.

body.description: The evaluation request body, as a JSON object or its JSON text.

name: recta_preflight
title: Preflight before a cross-chain transfer: cost, arrival and saving (free, no signature)
